Founded in 2017, Raintree Veterinary Clinic is one of Pune city's foremost veterinary clinics. With a range of services and facilities including multi-species care, specialised surgical facilities, alternative rehabilitative therapies, the latest in veterinary technology, and no small measure of love, Raintree stands for compassion and excellence in veterinary care.

For more information, please visit www.raintreevet.in

⚠️ Please note, we cannot consult for cases via YouTube comments and messages. In the event of an emergency, please call us on 8830207984 (if you are in Pune, India). For electronic consultations and requests for second opinions, our senior doctors can be e-consulted with on raintreevetclinic@gmail.com. For any other queries, find us on Instagram @raintreevet

Thank you for visiting our channel! We appreciate every comment and kind message.
